method: Independent read-only source review; no Android or Godot processes started during device QA.
resolved_findings: The entire animated cream backing blocks start-touch selection/panning and rejects floor drops.
Separate decorative panels preserve stable native hit targets and meaningful accessible names.
Pause and focus-loss cancel native armed presses and decorative tweens without toggling a category; selected toggle state is restored.
Pill minimum heights apply to native Panel geometry as well as calibrated StyleBox metadata.
Recovery text establishes wrap width before long content and fits above full-height action controls.
